name: release_train_orphan_watchdog_20261021
comment: ANCHOR: RELEASE_TRAIN_ORPHAN_WATCHDOG_20261021 — release-train arming finding 6. The claimer's watchdog moves a
non-terminal claim older than N min (default 2x the 3 h max run; TRADEAI_RELEASE_TRAIN_ORPHAN_AFTER_MIN or
--orphan-after-min) with no live owner (pid + /proc start time) from claimed/ to orphaned/, appends
orphaned.jsonl and raises one P2 (notifier + needs-action rule). Never deletes, never re-runs, writes no
receipt; train-orphan-resolve closes it only after train-reconcile. Hermetic: tmp_path world.
